original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚参议员Orji Kalu承认曾向出钱者出售武器
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿比亚北区参议员Orji Uzor Kalu在Arise电视台采访中承认，他此前曾从事重型武器国际贸易，向愿意付钱的个人和国家出售武器，而不考虑武器的用途。他表示自己卖枪是为了赚钱，后来在父母干预下退出该生意。相关说法目前仅来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚参议员Orji Uzor Kalu承认曾从事重型武器国际贸易
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: has admitted that he previously traded in heavy weapons internationally, selling to individuals and countries willing to pay without considering how the weapons would be used

key_facts.fact: Kalu称在Arise电视台采访中披露上述内容
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kalu, made the disclosure during an interview on Arise Television on Monday, November 9

key_facts.fact: Kalu称卖枪是为了赚钱，不考虑武器是否伤人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: I was selling guns to make money, whether they blow up [people], it's not my business

key_facts.fact: Kalu称在父母干预后退出武器生意
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: eventually abandoned the business after his parents intervened

uncertainties: 相关说法为Kalu本人受访自述，尚未获得独立核实
